name: GUDECA Branches
description: Branches of the Guneku Development and Cultural Association with dated activity in the community record.

branches.name: GUDECA Europe
branches.activity: Quarterly physical meetings and regular virtual meetings; annual gathering.

branches.name: GUDECA North America
branches.activity: Active; offered support to village initiatives in July 2026.
branches.relationshipNote: The register here keeps a GUDECA US chapter, seated across the DMV and New Jersey. Whether "North America" is that chapter under a wider name, or a separate body, is not established by any source held here. The two are therefore kept apart and neither is renamed. The Fondom to confirm.

note: No executive lists or membership figures are recorded here; none is established in the sources.
sourceNote: Branch activity recorded 2026-09-01 from the community record, and reviewed again 2026-09-16. No executive lists or membership figures are recorded here; none is established in the sources.
homeBranchNote: The community record establishes that GUDECA keeps a Home Branch executive at Guneku alongside the National executive. No roster of that executive is held here, so none is published: the structure is recorded, the seats are not filled by guesswork.
